members.name: wait
members.description:
Wait the given number of seconds before moving on. If no time is given,
waits for 0.05 seconds.  Motor control keeps running while it waits.

members.name: wait_until
members.description: Wait until the given condition (type: () -> bool) is satisfied.

members.name: wait_while
members.description: Wait while the given condition (type: () -> bool) is satisfied.

members.name: repeat_for
members.description:
Repeats a loop for the given number of seconds, counting the times
round from 0:

    for i in repeat_for(2):
        left.spin(30)
        right.spin(30)

members.name: drive_motor

members.name: motor_group

members.name: button

members.name: encoder

members.name: button_b

members.name: button_d

drive_motor.name: spin
drive_motor.description:
Spin the motor at the given power, from -100 to 100, for the given
number of seconds.  If no time is given, spins for 0.05 seconds.
With an encoder the motor keeps a steady speed whatever the load.

The motor stops when the time is up.  Calling `spin` again straight
away carries on from where it was, so a loop of `spin` calls runs
the motor smoothly, and a loop that spins two motors in turn keeps
both running.

drive_motor.name: spin_back
drive_motor.description: Spin the motor backwards; the same as `spin` with the power negated.

drive_motor.name: spin_degrees
drive_motor.description:
Spin the motor through the given number of degrees, negative for
backwards, at the given power, then brake.  Needs an encoder.
Turns add up exactly: two `spin_degrees(90)` make a half turn.

drive_motor.name: spin_back_degrees
drive_motor.description: Spin the motor backwards through the given number of degrees, then brake.

drive_motor.name: stop
drive_motor.description: Stops the motor and lets it turn freely.

drive_motor.name: brake
drive_motor.description: Stops the motor and holds it from turning freely.

drive_motor.name: get_encoder
drive_motor.description: Returns the motor's encoder, or None if it has none.

drive_motor.name: free_port
drive_motor.description: Frees the port for use by other components, disabling this motor.

motor_group.name: spin
motor_group.description:
Spins every motor at its share of the given power, from -100 to
100, for the given number of seconds.  If no time is given, spins
for 0.05 seconds.  With encoders the motors keep their ratios even
if one is held back.

The motors stop when the time is up.  Calling this again straight
away carries on, so a loop of calls drives smoothly.  Two
motor groups stepped in one loop add up.

motor_group.name: spin_back
motor_group.description: Spins backwards; the same as `spin` with the power negated.

motor_group.name: spin_degrees
motor_group.description:
Turns the motor with the largest ratio through the given number of
degrees, negative for backwards, and every other motor through its
share, all finishing together, then brakes.  Needs encoders on
every motor.

motor_group.name: spin_back_degrees
motor_group.description: Spins backwards by degrees; the same as `spin_degrees` negated.

motor_group.name: stop
motor_group.description: Stops every motor and lets them turn freely.

motor_group.name: brake
motor_group.description: Stops every motor and holds them from turning freely.

button.name: pressed
button.description: Returns true if the button is pressed, false otherwise.

button.name: held
button.description: Returns true if the button is held, false otherwise.

button.name: free_port
button.description: Frees the port for use by other buttons, disabling this one.

encoder.name: get_degrees
encoder.description: Returns how far the shaft has turned, in degrees, since the program started.

encoder.name: get_speed
encoder.description:
Returns how fast the shaft is turning, in degrees per second,
negative for backwards.

encoder.name: free_port
encoder.description: Frees the port for use by other components, disabling this encoder.

light.name: flash
light.description: Turns the LED on for the given number of seconds, then off.

light.name: toggle
light.description: Toggles the LED on or off, whichever it currently isn't.

light.name: free_port
light.description: Frees the port for use by other LEDs, disabling this one.
